initialization.difference_direction: own_boundary minus original; negative favors channel-wise boundary initialization
initialization.original: All boundary filter states initialized to first ambient value; heating states initialized to zero.
initialization.own_boundary: Each boundary filter state initialized to its own channel's first value; heating states initialized to zero.
initialization.macro: Arithmetic mean of profile RMSEs; each profile has equal weight.
initialization.pooled: Square root of sample-count-weighted profile MSE; different from macro RMSE.
initialization.fifths: Half-open bounds floor(n*b/5) to floor(n*(b+1)/5) on retained rows, b=0..4. Original profile indices begin at 300; fifths are not verified physical durations.
initialization.comparison: Two separately fitted historical procedures; current reanalysis does not fit models or isolate the physical rotor initial temperature.

methods.linear_residual: Complete unconstrained 33-feature ridge prior plus residual HGB

failure.support: Marginal min-max and 5th-95th percentile ranges are descriptive; they do not identify multivariate distribution shift or establish causes.
